description: Compute the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) between a starting and ending value over a number of years — the single constant yearly rate that would produce the same result. Also returns the total return and growth multiple. The correct way to annualise multi-year growth; an arithmetic average overstates it.

start_value.description: Value at the start. Must be positive.

years.description: Length of the period in years (fractions allowed).

name: cagr
title: Compound annual growth rate
